verdict.rationale: mParticle's docs list a 'Real-time API to drive user personalization' and a 'Get a complete view of your users' section, which point to a first-party profile-lookup capability. IDSync is documented as producing a unified view of known and anonymous identities. But the pack contains only page titles for the profile API, with no detail on what can be queried or how. Missing for 10: documented profile API endpoints and schema, evidence that traits, identifiers and event history are all retrievable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
